menus.name: Utopia tasting menu
menus.note: The only menu served on Fridays and Saturdays. Greek Terroirs pairing €110, Grand Cru €240, Fine and Rare €750, non-alcoholic pairing €110; a 'Full Supplement' version with the chef's premium ingredients is €475

menus.name: Genesis tasting menu
menus.note: Sunday to Thursday. Greek Terroirs pairing €75, Grand Cru €140, Fine and Rare €550, non-alcoholic €75

menus.name: Physis vegan menu
menus.note: Sunday to Thursday. Greek Terroirs pairing €95, Grand Cru €185, non-alcoholic €90

bookingOpens: Online through SevenRooms, or by phone or email (info@makrisathens.com). A prepayment of €50 a guest secures the table and comes off the final bill. Seats at the bar can also be booked.
cancellation: Cancel or change at least 48 hours ahead by phone or email. Later than that, or for a no-show, the €50-a-guest prepayment is kept. Tables may be released after 20 minutes' delay.
groups: Private and business dinners in the Aktiki private dining room, on the rooftop or at the restaurant's farm near Corinth, with a menu made for the group: send the enquiry form on the website.
duration: About two and a half hours for up to four guests, three hours for larger tables.
